facts.value: Moia enrage explosion ~25 damage per undead binder alive when the countdown ends; the countdown starts at 41 ticks and shortens by 2 ticks with each subsequent charge (not per death); a teammate death cuts team damage, so the shrinking timer makes a wipe likely
